limitations: All three IDs were returned by the official API, still include cs.RO and yield null under the unchanged admission function. This is not evidence of withdrawal or a universal relevance judgement.
Admission vocabulary is sensitive to wording changes and lacks many valid robotics terms. The examples expose that boundary without silently widening the rules or rewriting the source records.
The arXiv published date is the original arXiv submission date, not necessarily the research's first publication or public disclosure.
Candidate-count reconciliation and these targeted checks do not independently prove perfect candidate identities or semantic coverage. Earlier dated receipts remain immutable.
